text:
marta: Quick sync — I'm proposing a 'cohort optimizer' lane for model onboards that ties a small migration credit + pin window to passing a narrow bench set. Want to run tradeoffs now.

devon: +1. Are we talking pins that auto-expire or manual unpin?

marta: Prefer auto-expire with a short TTL (2–4 weeks) unless customer opts into extended pin. Auto-unpin helps capacity.

elaine: We need hardware buckets included in the gating. Some models only pass on A100/8k and shouldn't be on the same cohort as 4xA10 lanes.

sajid: For SLAs — what's the rollback path if the cohort triggers regressions in quality? We should define fast rollback and customer opt-out.

marta: Agreed. Draft checklist below. Comments?

```
cohort-optimizer launch gates v0:
- bench_delta: <= 1% latency regression vs baseline
- quality_delta: no >2% drop on core eval set
- hw_compat: restricted to declared hardware buckets
- pin_ttl: default 14 days (auto-unpin)
- migration_credit: one-time 2-week free credits for onboards
- rollback_plan: immediate pin-fallback to previous model + notify customers
```

devon: That looks reasonable. For quality_delta we need to specify which evals (spam, hallucination, core-llm); also who owns the evaluation artifact.

marta: Product will own the core eval set. Suggest we require a customer-facing eval slice if the model targets a labeled enterprise vertical.

elaine: Ops asks that we tag every cohort with a hardware_affinity field so routing can be enforced. Also, ensure the catalog UI shows the pin_ttl and migration_credit badge.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: model-catalog-tags, eval-artifact, hw-affinity present — all required for canary.

sajid: How aggressive are we on incentives? 2-week credit ok, but we should gate credits on actually routing >1000 tokens to validate real-world perf. Otherwise credits could be gamed.

marta: Good call. Add routing threshold to gate credits.

tyler: Timeline question — can we pilot this with 3 low-risk models next sprint? I can coordinate with infra to reserve dedicated lanes.

marta: Yes — pilot cohort of 3, low-risk, mixed hw buckets. Action items:
- devon: write formal eval spec (due in 48h)
- elaine: expose hw_affinity + UI badge (PR by EOW)
